purpose: Live sources that disagree about the same figure. Recorded, not resolved here: the atlas quotes whichever source it is reading, so a disagreement between sources surfaces as a disagreement between pages unless it is stated explicitly.

conflicts.subject: Agent Trust Bench (ATB) adversarial x402 profile count
conflicts.measured: six sources give five different figures; four of those sources were probed and all returned HTTP 200 (three distinct hosts), and no artefact proves any single count

sources.says: 187 adversarial x402 profiles across 42 threat categories

agent-trust-bench GitHub repo description (gh api repos/chopmob-cloud/agent-trust-bench)

conflicts.resolution: Unresolved. The live API is the only machine-checkable enumeration and it does not match any published headline. No number is asserted in the atlas; the upstream figure is quoted with its source and this table states the discrepancy.
conflicts.fix_at: agent-trust-bench (single source of truth for the profile count, surfaced through its API), then docs.algovoi.co.uk/agent-trust-bench, the algovoi-atb README, its PyPI summary and its GitHub description. Once those agree, delete this entry and let the atlas quote the reconciled figure.
